modules.name: Strata
modules.description: Chord player and harmony leader for house and techno: 16 styles and 93 progressions (Detroit, Chicago, deep, garage, dub, warehouse, acid, minimal, electro, ambient, IDM, piano, disco, progressive, melodic, soulful), voice-led voicings, stab rhythms and DRIFT that lets the chords wander. Follows poly chords from a Hapax. Undertow and Signal follow it with no cables. Notes out

modules.name: Undertow
modules.description: Bass line player for Strata: offbeat, rolling, acid, Reese, dub, electro, Chicago, pedal, 2-step, sub and broken lines that follow the chords, leave room for your kick and slide and accent like a 303. Notes out

modules.name: Signal
modules.description: Melody player for Strata: string lines, arps, hooks, call and answer, bleeps, leads, acid lines and glitches from a short motif that MUTATE slowly evolves. Plays into the gaps between the chords. Notes out
